Class Apartment

java.lang.Object
com.realestate.management.model.Apartment
public class Apartment extends Object
Represents a residential unit (Apartment) within a building.

This class manages the lifecycle of the property (Apartment.Status.FREE, Apartment.Status.RESERVED, Apartment.Status.SOLD), its physical attributes, and the transaction logic including quality tiers.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez

  • Field Details

    • status

      private Apartment.Status status
      The current lifecycle status of the apartment. Possible values: Apartment.Status.FREE, Apartment.Status.RESERVED, or Apartment.Status.SOLD.

    • basePrice

      private double basePrice
      The base monetary value of the unit in euros, before applying any quality multipliers.

    • squareMeters

      private double squareMeters
      The total surface area of the apartment in square meters.

    • rooms

      private int rooms
      The number of bedrooms/rooms available in the unit.

    • buyerDni

      private String buyerDni
      The unique identification of the current buyer or person reserving the unit. It is null if the apartment is Apartment.Status.FREE.

    • quality

      private Apartment.Quality quality
      The specific quality tier assigned to this unit. It affects the final price calculation. It is null if not yet assigned. See getPrice() for calculation details.

  • Constructor Details

    • Apartment

      public Apartment(double basePrice, double squareMeters, int rooms)
      Creates a new Apartment with the specified structural attributes. The initial status is set to Apartment.Status.FREE.
      Parameters:
      basePrice - The base monetary value of the unit in euros.
      squareMeters - The total surface area in square meters.
      rooms - The number of rooms in the unit.

    • setStatus

      public void setStatus(Apartment.Status status)
      Sets the status of the apartment manually.

      Note: It is recommended to use sell(String, Quality) or reserve(String, Quality) to maintain data consistency.

      Parameters:
      status - The new Apartment.Status to set.

    • getPrice

      public double getPrice()
      Calculates the final price of the apartment.

      If a Apartment.Quality tier is assigned, the base price is multiplied by the tier factor (defined in Apartment.Quality.getMultiplier()).

      Returns:
      The calculated final price.

    • sell

      public boolean sell(String dni, Apartment.Quality quality)
      Marks the apartment as Apartment.Status.SOLD to a specific buyer with a specific quality tier. Validates that the DNI is valid before proceeding.
      Parameters:
      dni - The identification of the buyer (cannot be null or empty).
      quality - The quality tier chosen for the finishings.
      Returns:
      true if the operation was successful, false if DNI was invalid.

    • sell

      public boolean sell(String dni)
      Overloaded method. Marks the apartment as Apartment.Status.SOLD with Apartment.Quality.STANDARD quality by default.
      Parameters:
      dni - The identification of the buyer.
      Returns:
      true if the operation was successful.

    • release

      public void release()
      Releases the apartment, resetting it to its initial available state.

      Sets status to Apartment.Status.FREE, and clears buyerDni and quality (sets them to null).

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a single-character code representing the status. Useful for grid visualizations.
      Overrides:
      toString in class Object
      Returns:
      "F" for Apartment.Status.FREE, "R" for Apartment.Status.RESERVED, "S" for Apartment.Status.SOLD.
